title: c18: unmodified r-two56 cogs from full-domain noise on a closed food-waste cycle; local food cut on one cog per seed with a fed twin (E), toward an SIBE claim
summary: Pack of lcn with k0 at full weight (pure r-two56) on 4 seeds from noise, then a local supply cut around one isolated cog per seed against its fed twin, plus a dt/2 check.
